title: Olive talks about her manifesto tour

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Hey! What in CORA's name are you looking at me for!? I didn't lose your money, you spent it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! What in CORA's name are you looking at me for!? I didn't lose your money, you spent it!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Confused? CONFUSED?! I'm not confused! I'm drunk!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Confused? CONFUSED?! I'm not confused! I'm drunk!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Wait, you're not in the movement...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, you're not in the movement...

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Look, it happened like this... Those rat bastards in the movement who want to ratify the charter decided we all have to vote, and voting was mandatory. But how are we supposed to enforce that, you know? We're getting as bad as the Corps at this stage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, it happened like this... Those rat bastards in the movement who want to ratify the charter decided we all have to vote, and voting was mandatory. But how are we supposed to enforce that, you know? We're getting as bad as the Corps at this stage.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Huh? The Movement to free Nivalis bay-bee! You know what it's about! You know what needs to happen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh? The Movement to free Nivalis bay-bee! You know what it's about! You know what needs to happen.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Soap...? Oh fuck! The soap! I totally forgot about the soap. Uh... no. The soap was a... not a mistake exactly. I mean it wasn't a success. What we need now is revolution.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Soap...? Oh fuck! The soap! I totally forgot about the soap. Uh... no. The soap was a... not a mistake exactly. I mean it wasn't a success. What we need now is revolution.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Right! I mean it should be. They call me an accelerationist, like that's a bad thing. But we're really gonna have to fuck this place up worse if we want to convince people that it needs to be un-fucked, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! I mean it should be. They call me an accelerationist, like that's a bad thing. But we're really gonna have to fuck this place up worse if we want to convince people that it needs to be un-fucked, right?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: RIGHT! Hey, maybe I had you pegged all wrong. I had you down as a shill gronk with a bottom line addiction, but maybe you've got some headroll inclinations, am I right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: RIGHT! Hey, maybe I had you pegged all wrong. I had you down as a shill gronk with a bottom line addiction, but maybe you've got some headroll inclinations, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Typical shill gronk with a bottom line addiction, huh? Figured you might have some headroll inclinations, but I guess I was wrong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Typical shill gronk with a bottom line addiction, huh? Figured you might have some headroll inclinations, but I guess I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Realist? The reallest disappointment more like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Realist? The reallest disappointment more like.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I like the rhetoric, friendo. We should get galactic cocktails some time. I need someone to practice my speeches on. And maybe I need a proofreader for my manifesto. I can never tell the difference between there and their and that other one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like the rhetoric, friendo. We should get galactic cocktails some time. I need someone to practice my speeches on. And maybe I need a proofreader for my manifesto. I can never tell the difference between there and their and that other one.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Huh? Yeah, whatever. Listen, I'm going on a speaking tour. I'm just worried no one will come. Or worse, my mom will come. Will you be in the crowd? Please.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh? Yeah, whatever. Listen, I'm going on a speaking tour. I'm just worried no one will come. Or worse, my mom will come. Will you be in the crowd? Please.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Meridian is next on the calendar. Just come! I swear, my words will change your life. Come see me talk, ok? It's just the start of the tour. If you come to every venue, I'll... give you a prize.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meridian is next on the calendar. Just come! I swear, my words will change your life. Come see me talk, ok? It's just the start of the tour. If you come to every venue, I'll... give you a prize.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Something good! Not just a hug. Will you come?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something good! Not just a hug. Will you come?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Do better than try friendo! This is the final fire. We all gotta dance in the flames as the last lights burn out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do better than try friendo! This is the final fire. We all gotta dance in the flames as the last lights burn out.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I get it. Some people aren't ready to dance in the flames of the final fire. They're still looking at their bottom line, even as their designer suit catches aflame.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it. Some people aren't ready to dance in the flames of the final fire. They're still looking at their bottom line, even as their designer suit catches aflame.
